programme.title: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: Shane Meadows' thriller is set in a small, bleak Derbyshire town. After seven years in the army, Richard (Paddy Considine) returns to find out what happened to his beloved brother Anthony (Toby Kebbell), who latched on to the local drugs cartel and became the butt of their cruelty. As Richard begins to take revenge against the gang, led by Sonny (Gary Stretch), the story of Anthony's life and fate unfolds through flashback and revelations. This screening is introduced by the director.

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: When an outcast in a private school meets the school's security guard and asks him to teach him maths, their friendship is put at risk after an incident there.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: Granny Nanny
programme.desc: A group of pensioners want to escape the boredom of their everyday life.

programme.title: We Love You, You Bastard
programme.desc: A war photographer and absent father, who spends more time taking care of his camera than his four daughters, enjoys a happy life in the Alps with his new girlfriend. But his life is turned upside down the day that his best friend tries to reconcilate him with his family by telling them a big lie.

programme.title: Thunderpants
programme.desc: An 11-year-old boy's amazing ability to break wind leads him first to fame and then to death row before it helps him to fulfil his ambition of becoming an astronaut.

programme.title: My First Time
programme.desc: Zachary is 20 years old. Dark and independent, he collects amorous conquests and school failure. Sarah is 18 years old. First class, fragile, she fills her emotional gaps with perfect control of his life. Nothing should close and yet, the year of the tank, for six months, they will live a love against which nothing can be, the true, the big one that marks a life forever.

programme.title: Lucky Break
programme.desc: Director Peter Cattaneo followed up his success in The Full Monty with this prison-based comedy drama. James Nesbitt plays Jimmy Hands, an inept robber determined to escape prison under the cover of governor Graham Mortimer's (Christopher Plummer) self-penned musical about Nelson (which Stephen Fry wrote especially for the film). Even within the prison walls, there's a chance for romance with visiting psychiatrist Annabel Sweep (Olivia Williams). But can Jimmy, together with Roger, Rudy and Cliff (Bill Nighy, Lennie James and Timothy Spall), join her on the outside?

programme.title: Tenor
programme.desc: While working part-time as a food deliveryman, Antoine, an aspiring young rapper from the suburbs of Paris, meets Mrs. Loiseau, an eminent teacher at the Paris Opéra. Stunned by the young man's raw talent, she introduces him to the world of opera. As Antoine becomes one of Mrs. Loiseau's students, he hides his new dream from his friends and family, fearing that they won't understand - this double life burdens him... Somewhere in between the gilded and uptight Parisian upper-class, and the harsh yet free-spirited and familiar suburbs he grew up in, Antoine will have to find his own voice.

programme.title: April And the Extraordinary World
programme.desc: April and the Extraordinary World is a 2015 French-Belgian-Canadian animated science fiction adventure film co-directed by Christian Desmares and Franck Ekinci. In 1870 on the eve of the Franco-Prussian War, French Emperor Napoleon III, accompanied by Marshal Bazaine, visits the lab of Gustave Franklin to access his project of breeding invulnerable supersoldiers. The emperor is disgusted with the results—two intelligent, talking komodo dragons ill-fit for war—and orders Bazaine to shoot them, but the creatures escape and the emperor instead causes an explosion that kills all three present. Napoleon III's successor then negotiates a settlement with Prussia to avert war, thus securing the throne to the House of Bonaparte.

programme.title: All Our Desires
programme.desc: Moved by the plight of the mother of her daughter's school friend, a young judge facing an incurable disease teams up with an older colleague in order to fight against financial companies that exploit the poor.

programme.title: Something in the Air
programme.desc: Written and directed by Olivier Assayas, Something in the Air is a poignant, semi-autobiographical film set in France a few years after the huge political and civil unrest of 1968, a borderline revolution that almost brought the country to a standstill. In 1971, a group of teenagers are still feeling the momentum of the movement, alongside disappointment that the dust is settling with little apparent change. Gilles (Clément Métayer) is finishing up at school and getting ready for art college, but his mind is filled with hard (and often conflicting) political ideologies, and as debates turn into demonstrations, and demonstrations turn into violent attacks against state, he meets more people who are angry with the political status quo, including Christine (Lola Créton), who's part of a film-making movement that celebrates the working class. Something in the Air is a moving and sometimes funny film about social inequality, and pays sound attention to a fascinating point of recent European history that is often overlooked.

programme.title: Robe Of Gems
programme.desc: Isabel and her family take possession of her mother's villa in rural Mexico where they reconnect with their long-time domestic worker Maria. But things have never been the same since Isabel's mother left. Once so well looked after, the house is now bare and neglected. Isabel and her husband are growing apart, and their children are increasingly worried about them. Maria's sister's disappearance has left her family in distress and forced her to engage in criminal activities with Adan, the son of a local policeman. Isabel decides to go on a dangerous quest, neglecting her own children, as well as her housekeeper's warning that she does not understand how things work in Mexico's poorer regions.

programme.title: Sorry Angel
programme.desc: 1993. Jacques (Pierre Deladonchamps) is a 39-year-old gay author living and working in Paris. He is a part-time, albeit inattentive, father to his young son Loulou, who stays with him every other night. Loulou is accustomed to his father's bouts of self-indulgent melancholy as well as his manic appreciation for the arts and his string of young lovers. At the same time, Jacques is in the process of coming to terms with his health's steady decline due to AIDS, which is simultaneously and severely affecting his ex-lover Marco. When Marco is rejected by his lover Thierry and comes to stay with Jacques, the two discuss again their intentions to commit suicide before they can be claimed by the disease. Jacques lives on the floor below his good friend Mathieu (Denis Podalydès), an older gay man and newspaper editor who regular caters to Jacques' flamboyant episodes.

programme.title: Meet the Penguins
programme.desc: Meet the Penguins is a documentary that follows the team of the Sancob Seabird Hospital in Cape Town, as they rescue penguins in need of help they encounter on the coast. These experts and volunteers give medical treatment, feed and support the incredible and vulnerable creatures, as they get ready to go back into the wild. Even when the odds are stacked the staff is dedicated to help the penguins get back on their feet. Meet the adorable characters of the penguins, each with a story of their own and a distinct personality.

programme.title: Animal Cribs
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: How Do Animals Do That?
programme.desc: How Do Animals Do That is a documentary series where experts answer various questions about the animal kingdom, revealing some amazing fun facts along the way. Animals have super powers humans can only dream of, they can do incredible things. The series provides answers to the questions how they do it and why. Find out why moths are attracted to flames, why turtles cry, why sea otters bond with stones, and why dogs wag their tails.

The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.title: Wild Dubai
programme.desc: Wild Dubai explores the vast – often hidden – wildlife of the largest city in the United Arab Emirates, as it journeys through the traditions of camel racing and falconry, reflecting the impact of heritage on the commitment to protect the wider environment and its wildlife.

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: This time we are off to Nevada on the hunt for the Camel Spider. This arachnid, sometimes called a wind scorpion, is neither a true spider nor a scorpion. Only 6 inches long, they a voracious feeders and prey on termites, darkling beetles and other ground dwelling insects. This little giant has been known to feed on snakes, small lizards, birds and rodents. They do not normally attack humans, but when they do, their bite can be extremely painful.

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive
programme.desc: Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: The first day of darkness has arrived at the refuge. Now, the days are growing shorter, causing Bob, Heimo and the Lewis family to set additional traps and continue hunting for food. Heimo uses what little daylight there is to catch his biggest adversary and competition for resources - the wolf. But overflow on the river blocks his path home and jeopardizes his golden rule of surviving the winter: "Always return home before the faint light of day is gone." Bob returns to the refuge from town and begins to follow fresh animal tracks as a result of the constant snowfall. Ray's daughters, Emma, Sarah and Molly, become emotional after what might be their last winter at the refuge as a family.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Big Fish Man
programme.desc: World record-holding angler Jakub Vagner would die for fishing and has come close more than once. In Big Fish Man he embarks on extreme fishing expeditions to the most remote regions of the world in search of fish that have never before been filmed in the wild many weighing more than 200kg and measuring over six metres in length. His exploits take us to a variety of remote locations Congo, Mongolia, Europe, Canada, Thailand, Ecuador and Peru. Carrying all his kit and supplies, Jakub spends days trekking through unforgiving jungle and paddling against wild river currents. He survives using the hunting and foraging skills hes honed over almost two decades of fishing missions. On his visually stunning adventure he tries to land the Amazons largest freshwater fish in Ecuador and the mighty Goliath Tiger Fish, with its 32 shark-like teeth, in Congo. He enlists the help of nomadic reindeer herders to land a giant Taimen in the ice cold rapids of the Shishgid River in Mongolia and tries to catch a massive Northern Pike in the Canadian sub-Arctic even though their natural habitat is completely frozen over. The series is packed with drama and danger. Jakub is stubborn and determined as time after time he faces nature at its most extreme.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Chef Grudge Match
programme.desc: Host Laila Ali challenges chefs to settle their disputes in a single round, head-to-head culinary battle. They all come here to call each other out, put their favorite knives on the line, and bury the hatchet. The winners walk out with $10,000 cash, a prized knife from the losing chef's knife roll and bragging rights for life!

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is in her kitchen cooking with her kid film crew and serving up a dish for each one. For daughter Paige, there's a Chickpea Curry Bowl, and a Jalapeno Bacon Cheeseburger Mac with son-in-law Mauricio's name written all over it. Next, there's two takes on French Bread Pizzas for daughter Alex and a decadent Layered Brownie Skillet Sundae for nephew Stuart. The kids are in the kitchen, shooting, cooking and eating.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is making a well-earned lunch for Ladd and his new cowgirl, Paige, who are out shipping cattle. There's amazing Pasta with Pancetta and Corn, perfect for her pasta-loving daughter who has just joined the family business. On the side, there's delicious Lemon Pepper Chopped Salad and fantastic Individual Skillet Focaccia. For dessert, Ree has rancher-approved Easy Chocolate Orange Ice Cream.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: Sun's out, grills out! Michael Symon soaks up the summertime weather and fires up his grill to encourage everyone to get cooking out with his easy and crowd-pleasing outdoor dinners. From sticky ribs to desserts, Michael shares his grilling tips and tricks to make every meal flamingly delicious. Self-shot from his New York backyard, cook along with Michael as he works live fire to show how simple and fun it is to make amazing dishes on the outdoor grill.

programme.desc: Bobby and Giada source high-end local ingredients and visit an iconic winery in the hills of Tuscany. Then, they suit up to learn the art of beekeeping.

programme.title: Outchef'd
programme.desc: Host Eddie Jackson gives everyday home cooks the shock of their lives when he reveals that they've actually shown up not to audition, but to face off in a one-on-one cooking challenge against culinary greats like Alex Guarnaschelli, Geoffrey Zakarian and Anne Burrell.

programme.title: Outchef'd
programme.desc: Eddie Jackson shocks home cook Luke Smedley with a chance to go head-to-head against the world famous Chef Maneet Chauhan. At the end of their pork battle, only one vote from a panel of judges off the streets of New York City will decide if Luke walks away with the $5,000 prize.

programme.title: Ciao House
programme.desc: Hosts and judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Gabe Bertaccini welcome 10 talented chefs to Ciao House, where they will live together in a beautiful Tuscan villa and be tested like never before on their proficiency with Italian cuisine. Two chefs receive a huge advantage going into the next round, and one chef must say "Ciao Ciao" to the villa.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

Epsiodes include a journey deep into the Cambodian jungle to search for a monster from a lost city; a spelunking expedition sees the team investigating the largest cave system in the world; an active volcano in Washington state might hold the clue to some extraterrestrial mysteries; and an exploration of a haunted dwelling in the Amazon causes panic in the middle of the night.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: Abalone Wars
programme.desc: In the world of the professional abalone diver, it's an unceasing battle with the elements and as the Winter cease-fire ends, the Spring offensive begins. Howard Rodd's, young sons are stepping up: Dene makes his first professional abalone dive, trained by his excitable older brother Neil. The very real risks that saw their father lose two crew members over his career are in the forefront of these young minds as they dive together into the precarious depths of the abalone beds. Further up the coast the Craig boys also keep it in the family. Twins Tobias and Tyrone shell for big brother Ben, also recovering from the shock of a recent shark encounter. Desperate to make a better go of it, Dominic "the Dominator" has ruffled a few feathers by joining a new team with better prospects... but his engine blows up. With the pressure on to fill a giant order of live abalone in just a few days he borrows a boat once belonging to a fallen friend, and it's a move that will make or break him. Meanwhile shady characters connected to the world of organised crime are still illegally depleting the stocks of abalone and the local fisheries patrol officers continue their year-long war with unscrupulous abalone poachers.

programme.title: Dive Wars Australia
programme.desc: A fascinating look at the work of daring individuals who hunt for abalone in some of the world's most dangerous and hostile waters. The crews face harsh conditions of the unpredictable waters as the hunting season starts, trying to catch as much abalone as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: The Autobahn A2
programme.desc: Using the example of the 473-kilometre long Bundesautobahn 2 between Oberhausen and Berlin, the work of firefighters, doctors, police and customs is presented. On the highway there are also construction sites, rest areas and the work on roads and bridges is shown and portray tourists, travelers and truckers.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: A lobsterman from Maine relives a harrowing encounter that has haunted him for years. A family witnesses a strange string of lights in the sky.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain
programme.desc: The documentary series accompanies the border guards of Spain in their daily fight against crime - on land, at sea and in the air. Around the clock, the men and women are on duty to pre-empt drug traffickers, smugglers and smugglers. The role of the security forces is manifold: from the fight against hashish transport in the strait of Gibraltar to the smashing of organized human trafficking at the airport in Madrid to the search for counterfeit branded goods in the port of Barcelona.

programme.title: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Gold Rush is a reality television series that follows the placer gold mining efforts of various family-run mining companies in boundless north of America. The series focuses on the work process in the conditions of permafrost and working relations between the participants. The show has 10 seasons altogether. In some episodes participants start the adventure and travel to Alaska to search for gold because of financial issues. They do not have any previous experience and have to learn on the job. Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich.

programme.title: 90 Day: The Single Life
programme.desc: Follow a group of people from the series ''90 Day Fiancé'', whose international relationships fell apart, as they embark on a new adventure, and start going on dates in an attempt to find love - again. Some of audience's favourites - Big Ed, Colt, Danielle, Molly, and others, are searching for someone new, and you can join them on their journey.

programme.title: Addicted To Marriage
programme.desc: Addicted to Marriage follows the lives of four intriguing women who love to get married. Meet Monette, Shae, Amy, and Kecia, who collectively have been down the aisle a total of 20 times! Each marriage enthusiast is ready to say "I do" again, but are the men in their lives ready? Some of the women know exactly what they want in a future marriage while others struggle with their pasts. One of the brides-to-be has a list she refers to as the 'Triple A': attention, affection and appreciation whereas others grapple with revealing how many times they've said 'I do' because of their lurking insecurities of potentially failing at yet another marriage. The women know they trust quickly and love hard but the relationship highs are often met with intense drama and scrutiny by the men they love. Will their willingness for a happy ending with Prince Charming push the men in their life away or will they finally have the happily ever after they have been longing for?

programme.title: Love & Translation
programme.desc: The series brings three American men and 12 international women together on a remote paradise island for a chance at finding romance. And here's the twist: none of the women speak English and none of the men speak other languages. Without being able to speak to one another and without the use of translators, the singles need to count on their senses to help develop their connection and determine the power of their chemistry and attraction.

programme.title: Rubiales vs Hermoso: The World Cup Kiss
programme.desc: As Spain's players received their medals after defeating England in Sydney to win the 2023 World Cup, Rubiales grabbed Hermoso by the head and kissed her on the lips. The incident triggered protests and calls for the resignation of Rubiales, who has said he will appeal against the verdict.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress With Tan France
programme.desc: Sarah's determined that her fiancé's Asian traditions play a big part in their wedding. Meanwhile, Tan helps Tara find a dress that's both sexy and classy!

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress With Tan France

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: December 27th, 1991 -- Scandinavian Airlines Flight #751 is negotiating snow and slush on the tarmac at Stockholm-Arlanda Airport. The DC-9 has been de-iced twice to ensure it's safe for take-off. Despite the winter conditions, the aircraft takes off smoothly. But within seconds, the engines begin emitting a series of rapid-fire booming noises, smoke begins filtering through the cabin, and less than two minutes later, both engines fail. As the pilots try restarting them, the left engine erupts in flames. 3,200 feet above the ground, the plane has lost all power and is falling quickly and silently from the sky. The plane hits the ground, breaking into three pieces, but remarkably everyone on board survives. But can investigators determine what brought down the nearly new, state-of-the-art jetliner?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: During a regional commuter hop in New Zealand, the pilots of Eagle Airways Flight 2300 struggle to lower their landing gear. They circle the airport to troubleshoot the issue. Low on fuel, they have no choice but to eventually attempt a wheels-up landing. With emergency crews standing by, their twin-engine turboprop gently touches down, slides along the centre of the runway, and comes to a stop—remarkably with no injuries and minimal damage to the aircraft. With a potential disaster narrowly averted, investigators look into what could have caused the landing gear to fail. They soon track a hydraulic leak to a minor part with a major flaw. When they later test the entire fleet of Beechcraft turboprops, they uncover a systemic issue that's endangering passengers worldwide.

programme.title: World Eats Bread
programme.desc: The Fertile Crescent is where the seeds of bread were first planted millenia ago - and to this day Turkey eats more of it than just about any other nation. This is the tale of two of their most beloved loaves: simit, the fuel that powers the thriving city of Istanbul, and Ramadan pide, a once-a-year delicacy that represents compassion and generosity - even in trying times.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Head-butting may be acceptable among rams and goats, but for humans its a little more painful. Plates, cans, watermelons…some people dont seem to know when to stop challenging the thickness of their skull. Ice-skating can be so fraught with risks that its often best to just focus on staying upright and moving forwards. With so many techniques to master, practice really makes perfect. But at what point does perseverance become torture?

We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Canary Islands: Born of Fire
programme.desc: Marvel at the awesome power of nature as exclusive 6K footage displays the change evoked by a massive volcanic eruption of Cumbre Vieja Volcano in Canary Islands. Follow the main geologists and volcanologists fighting the 84 days eruption and learn about the formation of the Canary Islands.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry decodes Spain's cultural contradictions. Starting in Madrid, she tries her hand at flamenco and learns how the artform combines both technical discipline and the freedom of improvisation. In Valencia she reveals the origins of paella - a fiercely regional dish that owes its existence to an irrigation system built by invaders from Africa over 700 years ago. In the Canary Islands, where Christoper Colombus first set sail for the Americas, she discovers an ancient whistling language which endured as Spanish conquered the world. Back on the mainland she indulges her love of urban planning in Barcelona, revealing how much of the city's easy charm is built on strict geometric discipline. And in a heart stopping finale, she witnesses the strong community bonds at the heart of gravity-defying human pyramids.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Festival season has kicked off in the city, culminating in the Amsterdam Dance Event, the world's largest electronic music festival. Around 500,000 dance enthusiasts from around the world are gathering in Amsterdam to attend the festivities. This means tens of thousands of extra passengers at the station. Safety & Service staff Menno and Baran are busy dealing with visitors who are using drugs excessively. Veteran Menno tries to keep his new colleague Baran in check when he chases a troublemaker who is under the influence. Amsterdam Central is also joining in the festivities, with various stages and a special Dance Train featuring a DJ. On board, conductor Errol is transported back to his time as a party animal.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The hunt for a high-value target: The unforeseen arrest of an American operative in Pakistan threatens to unravel one of the most secretive and high-stakes missions in CIA history. As international tensions flare and political pressure mounts, the experienced chief of station finds himself at the center of a dangerous storm. With limited allies and a target on his back, the clock is ticking. He must navigate a volatile diplomatic crisis while staying focused on the mission — capturing the U.S.'s most wanted fugitive — before everything falls apart.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: From CIA wife to CIA spy: The widow of a CIA officer, who was killed in action, chooses to take up the mantle, becoming the first woman to go undercover in Moscow and handle one of the most important Russian sources of the Cold War.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: Empires and lives have been won and lost over secrets kept and secrets revealed. We look at espionage; meeting spies from Delilah to Roald Dahl and along the way revealing the real model for James Bond. What does it take to make them successful? And how many people can know a secret before it isn't secret anymore?

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: We discover you can start a war over almost anything, from an unprovoked invasion to a lost ear. Some battles have been fought over a pastry or a stolen bucket. We look at wars that lasted for centuries and others that were over in minutes and we learn that though it's easy to start a war it's far more difficult to end one.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Amid civil war in 14th century Mongol-controlled China, scholar and strategist Liu Bowen lends his talents to a dynasty on the rise. But his name is also remembered for a more mysterious talent: fortune-telling with what some say is frightening precision. A series of cryptic prophecies earns him the moniker of China's "Nostradamus." In Ancient Rome, Julius Caesar receives a warning that his life is in danger. The prophecy, uttered by an Etruscan soothsayer, is divined through the strange art of haruspicy. Caesar ignores the omen at his own peril. Amongst the hills of the Scottish Lowlands, the influential Erskine family becomes haunted by a mysterious prophecy, presaging and inflicting countless moments of tragedy and heartbreak.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Edgar Cayce, known as the "sleeping prophet," claims to use hypnotic states to heal the sick and see the future. Cayce is alleged to have predicted the Wall Street Crash of 1929, the Second World War, and the assassination of JFK. His aura stokes fear around his most frightening prediction of all — the end of the world. In Ancient Greece, the Oracle of Delphi is the premier prophesier of the ancient world. The words of this Pythia, channeled down from Apollo, go on to shape human history, foretelling the rise and fall of empires. And in 19th-century France, radical occult thinker Eliphas Lévi draws upon early mysticism to develop a spiritual doctrine. Branded as a devil worshiper by the public, the truth of his life's work is even stranger.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Under the muck of a Danish bog, a 2,400-year-old body is found so perfectly preserved the stubble on the dead man's chin is visible … as is the rope around his neck. Is this ancient cold case what it seems? At the turn of the 20th century, physician Albert Abrams was inspired to apply the new discovery of radio waves to medicine. He invented a complex-looking machine to diagnose any disease. Thousands flocked to be tested, but the establishment was skeptical. At Berlin's Neues Museum, a bust of Egypt's Queen Nefertiti portrays a woman so stunning that she has become synonymous with flawless beauty. But when experts use advanced techniques to look beneath the surface, new questions are raised about the queen's appearance.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The lost colony of Roanoke is a historic mystery that has not been solved for over 400 years. An intriguing artifact was discovered in 1937: the Dare Stone. Apparently written by John White, it explains in detail what happened to the vanished colony. But is it real? World War I was the first major conflict to feature warplanes and, therefore, also the first to feature anti-air defence. How did an object resembling a satellite dish on wheels help gunners shoot down enemy planes? In Egypt, excavations of the Great Sphinx of Giza in 1817 uncovered six carved hunks of stone. Put together, they appear to be fragments of a large, braided stone beard, in the style of false beards worn by ancient pharaohs. The Sphinx never wore a beard … or did it?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: An out-of-control turboprop breaks apart while trying to land at Düsseldorf airport, instantly killing everyone on board. German investigators locate every piece of the wreckage within the huge crash site, then painstakingly reconstruct the entire plane in order to determine what went wrong on board Nuremberg Flight 108. Investigators soon uncover a piece of the wreckage with telltale signs of a lightning strike. And as they dig deeper, find conclusive evidence that the powerful jolt jumped from the fuselage to the electrical system, causing a total power failure that disabled critical instruments and plunged the cockpit into darkness. Faced with a one-in-a-million disaster scenario no one saw coming, the disoriented crew lost control of their aircraft. Investigators conclude there was nothing they could have done to save their plane.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: January 17th, 2008. Approaching the end of its ten-and a half hour journey from Beijing, British Airways Flight #38 is preparing to land in Heathrow. But just as the first officer takes over the controls, and only two minutes before it touches down, the aircraft is inexplicably crippled by double engine failure. Quickly falling out of the sky and with just seconds to react, the captain raises the plane's flaps to reduce drag. And while the plane narrowly misses the buildings and radio antennas in its path, it crashes just short of the runway, ripping off the engines and landing gear. Incredibly, all 152 people on board survive. But can investigators determine what brought down one of the world's most sophisticated jetliners?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Twenty minutes after taking off from Taipei, Taiwan a China Airlines 747 suddenly disappears from radar. A massive rescue mission is launched, ut all 225 passengers and crew are dead. After ruling out both a bomb and a gas tank explosion, investigators are stumped. They examine hundreds of pieces of wreckage until they discover a single piece of the hull that solves the riddle. Tragically, the crash of Flight 611 began with a problem that began twenty-two years earlier.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Just sending humans into space is a highly risky mission. Positioned on a rocket, astronauts must survive the controlled explosion that launches their spacecraft beyond the atmosphere and the terrifying frictional force during reentry. It's an unforgiving environment where minor errors have caused deadly and costly catastrophes. To future-proof their new deep-space capsule, Orion, NASA engineers must forensically examine every past disaster. From the devastating space shuttle explosions to the Apollo and Soyuz tragedies, yesterday's failures are vital lessons learned. Shaping new survival suits, improving escape systems and innovating new materials make space travel safer than ever before.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Tunnels can save money, time and the environment. They provide a shortcut through difficult-to-navigate landscapes, but tunnels themselves can be dangerous. In the worst-case scenario, a tunnel can turn into a tomb. And today's tunnels are longer, deeper and more daring than ever before. Examine two European mega projects: the longest underground rail excavation, the Brenner Bass Tunnel, and the world's longest immersed tunnel, the Fehmarnbelt link. As they break records and push boundaries, how can engineers use past disasters to make their tunnels safer for construction workers and motorists?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: For millions, Jesus is both the Son of God and an actual historical figure. But what archaeological evidence exists about the people and places that shaped his life? The investigation begins at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem, said to be built upon Jesus' burial place. But there's a puzzle: In the 1st century AD, burials only took place outside the city walls, yet the church sits firmly within the Old City. Can experts solve the mystery? Elsewhere in Jerusalem, archaeologists hunt for the site where Jesus is said to have performed the miraculous healing of a Blind man — the Siloam Pool — and look for clues about the events of his final days, including the Last Supper. Beyond Jerusalem, investigators hunt for the lost town of Bethsaida, site of the feeding of five thousand and home to three of his disciples.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: From ancient temples to soaring cathedrals, humanity's deepest beliefs have given rise to sacred architecture. Rome's Pantheon, with its perfect dome and mysterious oculus, blends beauty and functionality in ways that puzzle modern architects to this day. Rising majestically from the sea, the gravity-defying Mont Saint-Michel reveals the extraordinary vision and skill of its builders, who overcame tides and challenging foundations to construct a monastery high on a rocky island. And the Porta Nigra, the best-preserved Roman city gate north of the Alps, finds its fate hanging in the balance until a Greek hermit's arrival transforms this military stronghold into a sacred sanctuary, ensuring its survival through the centuries.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Midyat, Turkey, archaeologists uncover the vast underground city of Matiate, stretching across tunnels and chambers carved thousands of years ago. Evidence of churches, synagogues and Roman coins suggests it was once a refuge for people fleeing religious persecution. In Royston, England, workmen stumble upon a mysterious chalk-carved chamber filled with intricate religious carvings. Beneath Orvieto, Italy, a wine cellar excavation reveals Cavità 254, a striking Etruscan subterranean complex. Once a quarry or water system, its deliberate infilling with pottery and bones hints at ritual or symbolic burial practices. Finally, in Abarkuh, Iran, archaeologists map a massive subterranean tunnel network. Likely part of an ancient qanat water system, exemplifying Persian ingenuity, it used engineering to survive drought, war and desert heat.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Florida, construction workers uncover a brick-lined tunnel system beneath a historic neighborhood. Once dismissed as myth, these passages may have begun as early stormwater and sewage channels, but legends tie them to bootleggers and mobsters who thrived during the Prohibition era. In Italy, the Hypogeum of Cristallini Street opens a window into Hellenistic-era burial practices. Hidden beneath a 19th-century palace, this complex of painted tombs reveals a world of elite Greek families. In Iran, a man digging a well uncovers a sprawling three-story underground city. Built during the Sasanian Empire, it likely served as a defensive refuge from invaders. Finally, beneath Rome's Caelian Hill, subway construction exposed a second-century CE military barracks and luxury villa, possibly the praetorium of a Roman commander.

programme.title: Inside North Korea: The Kim Dynasty
programme.desc: The final episode starts with the death of Kim Jong Il and the rise of the new leader of North Korea - his son, Kim Jong Un, taking power at the age of 28. Using exclusive interviews, firsthand testimony and expertly curated archive, "Rocket Man" charts Un's reign from 2011 to present day; delves into how Un consolidated power, by killing his uncle and his half-brother; examines the incredible story of his unexpected friendship with basketball star Dennis Rodman; retells his announcing that he has nuclear weapons that can reach the United States; and breaks down the historic 2018 summit with US President Trump.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: From CIA wife to CIA spy: The widow of a CIA officer, who was killed in action, chooses to take up the mantle, becoming the first woman to go undercover in Moscow and handle one of the most important Russian sources of the Cold War.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: The U.S. Coast Guard stops smugglers with over 13,000 kilos of cocaine at sea and transfers custody to Homeland Security Investigations for prosecution. At Dulles International Airport, near the nation's capital, U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers uncover weapons heading outbound during checks for unreported currency. In El Paso, CBP Agricultural Specialists inspect live and deceased animals to protect the U.S. from foreign diseases, like avian flu.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: The Coastguard follow a smugglers' trail and make a remarkable discovery. A family in danger is rescued from a delicate situation. The Customs Surveillance team joins forces with their French colleagues to carry out a special operation on the island of Madeira. And in the Mediterranean Sea, divers work to protect historical Roman artefacts, while a sailing race may end in disaster.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: Cameras that monitor the coastline alert the coastguard to a well-known drug trafficker who seems to be back in action near Cadiz. Three patrol boats round up tobacco smugglers near Gibraltar, while another unit tracks down human traffickers off Cabo de Gata.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.desc: Möllukomöödia politseinikest Jimmyst ja Paulist, kes tagandatakse karistuseks erioperatsiooni kihva keeramise eest ajutiselt töölt. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Poseidon Crew loodab hooaja viimasel nädalal koguda piisavalt kulda, et meeskond koos hoida. Gold Devils ruunavad oma tehnikat purunemiseni ja Ferals peab toime tulema kõrvetava kuumusega.

programme.title: Kullasõjad Austraalias
programme.desc: Richie ja Kimberley saavad 1870. aastal kalliks mineva õppetunni, kui vanade partnerite Donnie ja Leigh vahel läheb suuremat sorti sõnasõjaks.

programme.title: Kullasõjad Austraalias
programme.desc: 1870. aastal toodab 50 000 dollarit maksev kuivpuhur kaevanduses väga vajalikku kulda; Ritchie reisib Kuldrannikule, et müüa 30 000 dollarit väärt kullatükk jõukale sõbrale.

programme.title: Yukoni kuld

programme.title: Yukoni kuld

programme.title: Yukoni kuld

programme.title: Yukoni kuld

programme.title: Yukoni kuld

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Poseidon Crew kaaluvad maatüki kindlustamist, kus võib peituda mitme miljoni dollari väärtuses kullakamakaid. Jacqui ja Andrew seiklevad Queenslandi põhjaosasse ja meeskond Ferals proovivad õnne eemal asuval saareekspeditsioonil.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Brent Shannoni kuldne unistus täitub või hääbub kaalumisel. Shane ja Russell suunduvad kurnavale 3000 km pikkusele ekspeditsioonile ning uus meeskond Gold Retrievers kaevavad välja rikkaliku saagi.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Katastroofiline tulekahju rikub Goldtimerite hooaja, Marcus ja Linden riskivad uue rendilepingu ja kalli masinavärgiga ning Feralsid on Robi kadudes sunnitud käivitama päästemissiooni.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Jacqui ja Andrew jäävad Palmer Riveri piirkonda lõksu, Shane'il ja Russellil on lõpuks võimalus leida rikkalik saak ning Poseidoni meeskonda ootab ees kriitiline kohtumine.

programme.title: Suur Hiina müür Ash Dykese silmade läbi
programme.desc: Ash uurib Zhangjiakou üht vanimat Suure müüri osa, mida kaheksa järjestikust dünastiat on kindlustanud, ja sukeldub Wulouggou iidsete maadeavastajate jälgedesse.

programme.title: Kollanokkadest rekajuhid
programme.desc: Juhtide puudus ähvardab Austraalia majanduskasvu seisata, kuid püünele on tõusmas uus põlvkond kollanokkadest rekajuhte; neid juhendavad juba kogenud ametikaaslased, kes on valmis teatepulka edasi andma.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid: kaevanduse SOS
programme.desc: Veteran-kullakütt Paul Mackie, geoloog Aaron Raddock ja logistikaekspert Melanie Wood reisivad Austraalia kõige karmimatesse kohtadesse, et aidata taastada kuut raskustes kullakaevandust.

programme.desc: Veteran-kullakütt Paul Mackie, geoloog Aaron Raddock ja logistikaekspert Melanie Wood reisivad Austraalia kõige karmimatesse kohtadesse, et aidata taastada kuut raskustes kullakaevandust.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid: kaevanduse SOS
programme.desc: Veteran-kullakütt Paul Mackie, geoloog Aaron Raddock ja logistikaekspert Melanie Wood reisivad Austraalia kõige karmimatesse kohtadesse, et aidata taastada kuut raskustes kullakaevandust.

programme.title: Murtud südamete saar
programme.desc: Daamid arutavad, kes on kolm viimast, kellega minna finaali. Ally lõplik kolmik on Joe, Chad ja Nuggett; Krystal ei suuda valida Paddy ja Dougi vahel ning kuskil hõljub ka veel Frank; ning Nicole'i valik on Jack, Seani ja nuhk Nathan. Toimuvad viimased grupikohtingud. Kõik kolm viimast esitavad oma seisukoha, miks peaksid just nemad finaali jõudma.

programme.title: Kingahooliku jõulud
programme.desc: Noelle on oma elus jõudnud ristteele. Kui ta jõululaupäeval kogemata oma töökohta lõksu jääb, ei arva ta sellest suurt midagi, kuniks ilmub välja kummaline daam, kes nimetab end ta kaitseingliks. Nüüd peab Noelle vaatama tõsiselt peeglisse ja oma elu üle järele mõtlema.

programme.title: Toidu ABC
programme.desc: "Toidu ABC" meenutab oma lemmikuid näksidega seotud missioone. Jimmy sukeldub erikujuliste kartulikrõpsude maailma ning uurib Tais, kui palju on krevetikrõpsudes krevette. Matt ei saa seakamarast üle ega ümber ja lisaks selgitab välja, kas maisikrõpse võib dipi sisse mitu korda kasta. Helen Lawal süveneb riisikookidesse ning Kate on Hawaiil makadaamiapähkli jälgedel ja arutab pähkliallergia teemat.

programme.title: Nigella lemmikroad
programme.desc: Nigella jagab oma lemmiktorti - jumalikku kihilist torti šokolaadi- ja maapähklivõiga, mis sunnib isegi kõige suuremat maapähklivõi vihkajat alla andma.

programme.title: Nigella lemmikroad
programme.desc: Nigella võtab käsile enim kirutud mere peekoni - anšoovised. Ta loob neist eliksiiri, mis sobib oivaliselt mahlase steigi või punase salatsiguriga.

programme.title: Viie tärni kokk
programme.desc: Pärastlõunatee ettevalmistamise ülesanne laseb mõnedel võistlejatel särada, teistele valmistab aga raskusi. Ning Langhami tippmeeskonna ees kokates tuleb kõigil oma sarm täiskäigul sisse lülitada.

programme.title: Hooaeg
programme.desc: Hooaja saade viib meid kurssi ilu- ja elustiili teemadega. Kindlasti leiab saatest uusimat infot nahahooldustoodete kohta, aga ka uudiseid moetrendide,- kodu ja tervise vallast! Saatejuht on Gabriela Kivimägi.

programme.title: Naised teavad
programme.desc: Uus inspireeriv ja praktiline laupäevahommikune saade naistele ja emadele, kes otsivad päris vastuseid päris elu küsimustele. Igas saates võtame aega, et süveneda teemadesse, mis naisi ja emasid päriselt kõnetavad. Olgu selleks tervis, enesehoid, pereelu või igapäevased valikud, mis teevad elu kergemaks. Külastame oma ala spetsialiste ning räägime asjadest nii, nagu need on. Saatejuht on särav Mia Liina Kraanat.

programme.title: Südamesoov
programme.desc: Suurpere isa Siimu elu muutus pöördumatult, kui perre sündis habraste luude haigust põdev poeg Karmo. Erilise lapse kasvatamine avas mõlema vanema südamed, mistõttu suur osa nende ajast kulub vabatahtlikena teiste aitamisele. Pere kõige suurem mure on aga seotud pojaga. Pidevad luumurrud on aheldanud esimese klassi poisi ratastooli ja koduseinte vahele, kuid vanemate südamesoov on, et nende laps saaks käia koolis nagu kõik teised temaealised.

programme.title: Kodustiil
programme.desc: Saates pakume inspiratsiooni, ideid ja praktilisi lahendusi, kuidas muuta oma kodu stiilsemaks, hubasemaks, nutikamaks, turvalisemaks, energiatõhusamaks ning üldse paigaks, kus on hea olla igal ajal ja iga ilmaga! Väärt ideid ja näpunäiteid jagub nii suvilasse, korterisse kui ka suurde majja ning aeda. Loome koos kodud hubaseks ja stiilseks! Saatejuht on Jaanus Koort.

programme.title: Rannamaja remondihundid
programme.desc: Äge suhtesari "Rannamaja" pakub vaatajatele kuhjaga romantilisi suhteid ning pööraseid seiklusi! Kuus noort ja vallalist kolivad elama rannamajja ühe eesmärgiga – luua romantilisi suhteid ja leida omale kaaslane. Kui kokkukolinute hulgas sobivat paarilist ei ole, siis korraldatakse pidusid eesmärgiga leida kaaslane pidutsedes. Juba esimeses episoodis selgub, et osalistevahelised tunded võivad tekkida väga kiiresti ning sama kiirelt võib kogu olukord võtta ka dramaatilise pöörde.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: DJ Nicholase kirg on trap-muusika. Kas ta kohtingukaaslane Mathilde jagab tema huvi? Portugallanna Ana ja brasiillane Rodrigo keeravad Ladina-Ameerika sarmile tuure peale. Brendan tahab "tibi" - Ellie võib aga teda üllatada. Kennedy otsib usaldusväärset ja seksikat kutti. Pealtnäha paistab Steve sobivat, kuid tema ei armasta pidutseda. Maapoiss Harry kohtub Keiraga, maaelust unistava linnaneiuga.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: 21-aastane Bianca on tudeng Sydneyst ühe barjääriga - ta on veel süütu. Tema kaaslane, 21-aastane Christian on Melbourne'is elav kreeklane. Zoe on 23-aastane ettevõtja, kes saadetakse kohtingule merejalaväelase Mattiga. Harry hindab spontaansust ja Lyndal saab tema huumorist aru. Angelina ja Josh vahetavad oma rajusid kogemusi kohtingutega. Jazz on valmis uuesti armastust leidma - kas Garethiga?

programme.title: Läbi sillerdava suve
programme.desc: Romantiline seiklusfilm Tiast, kes töötab Seattle'is oma isa advokaadibüroos, kuid saab onult unistuste pakkumise olla väikelaeva kapten. Laevaga korraldatakse õhtusöögikruiise San Francisco lahes, kuid muinasjutt võtab kiiresti kehva pöörde, sest laevakokk on ootamatult Tina kunagine peigmees.

programme.title: Kas abiellume?
programme.desc: Michelle ja Allen on suhtes. Nad kutsuvad viimaks vanemad külla, et neile abiellumise plaanist rääkida. Selgub aga, et nende vanemad juba tunnevad üksteist ja neil on abielust väga erinevad arvamused.

programme.title: Viie tärni kokk
programme.desc: Poolfinaal paneb proovile nelja võistleja piirid, kui neil tuleb valmistada peolauale peeni kaunistusi ja pakkuda reaalajas toitlustust 100 külalisega banketil.

programme.title: Emma Fielding: Kibedam kui surm
programme.desc: Krimifilmide sari pühendunud ja erakordselt taibukast arheoloogiaprofessorist Emma Fieldingust, kes alatasa mõrvamüsteeriumite tunnistajaks sattub. Emma Fielding külastab arheoloogide konverentsi, kus mürgitatakse organisatsiooni president. Kuna presidendi ametiposti on noolinud mitmed, on Emmal ja FBI agendil Jim Conneril ka kahtlusaluseid rohkem kui üks. Emma Fieldingu rollis telesarjadest "Melrose Place" ja "Kaks ja pool meest" tuttav Courtney Thorne Smith.

programme.title: Sassis
programme.desc: Eesti 2022 aasta parima teleseriaali preemia pälvinud komöödia "Sassis" on tagasi! Peategelase Evelin Kassi elu on nüüd veel rohkem sassis. Me näeme nii palju piinlikke vahejuhtumeid, kiiksuga karaktreid ja kiiva kiskuvaid inimsuhteid, et piss tuleb püksi. Evelini ja Velle abielu on karidel. Rivaalitsemine ja ärategemine käib iga asja pärast - olgu selleks raamatud, maja või lapsed. Naine aga ei kavatsegi lahutusjärgsesse depressiooni langeda: raevuka tarmukusega katsetab ta uusi rõivaid, suhteid ja kasvatusviise. Nagu ikka, mida rohkem sa pingutad, seda suurem on risk kõik veelgi hullemini sassi ajada.

programme.title: Emma Fielding: Kibedam kui surm
programme.desc: Krimifilmide sari pühendunud ja erakordselt taibukast arheoloogiaprofessorist Emma Fieldingust, kes alatasa mõrvamüsteeriumite tunnistajaks sattub.
